caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a glass pitcher, which is centrally placed on a plain, light-colored background. The pitcher is rendered in shades of green and features a large, rounded body that tapers at the neck and then flares out at the mouth. Its handle is robust, attached at the top near the rim and curving downward to join the midsection of the vessel. The surface of the pitcher displays swirling, decorative patterns in darker green tones, with several reflective highlights suggesting a glossy, translucent glass texture. The pitcher stands on a rounded, footed base, also depicted in green hues with shading to indicate its three-dimensional form. There are no other objects or embellishments around the pitcher, and in the lower right corner, the artist's name "VAN SILVAY" is handwritten.
title: Glass Pitcher
